faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar S-Type 2.5 V6 use?
faqLeft.a: The S-Type 2.5 V6 uses the AJ-V6 — a 2.5-litre V6 petrol engine. It was fitted from 1999 to 2008 across the X200 generation.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar S-Type 2.5 V6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,600. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my S-Type 2.5 V6?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the AJ-V6 engine before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ-V6 S-Type engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V6 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used S-Type 2.5 V6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my S-Type if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an S-Type 2.5 V6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most S-Type owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
